hackerrank.test_duration: HackerRank tests have a default duration. Accommodations can be added in multiples of 5% via Candidates > More > Add Time Accommodation.
hackerrank.test_retake: Candidates can retake a test if they are re-invited. Re-inviting a candidate archives the previous attempt. Candidates can be re-invited as many times as needed.
hackerrank.test_expiration: Tests remain active indefinitely unless start/end times are set in Settings > General. Expired tests disable new invitations and candidate access.
hackerrank.account_deletion: Users must set a password (if using Google login) via 'Forgot Password' before they can delete their account in Settings > Delete Accounts.
hackerrank.data_privacy: HackerRank is GDPR compliant. Users can manage privacy settings and data requests via the account settings.
hackerrank.billing_invoices: Invoices can be downloaded from Manage Subscription > Order History. If missing, contact support@hackerrank.com.
hackerrank.payment_methods: Payment information is processed via Stripe. Users can update card details in Manage Subscription > Update Payment Method.
hackerrank.support_channels: Work platform users: support@hackerrank.com. Candidates: candidate-care@hackerrank.com. Community: help center.
hackerrank.test_variants: Variants adapt one test to different profiles. A test must have at least two variants. Variants without logic are hidden from candidates.

claude.support_access: Pro/Max plans and Enterprise owners have messenger support. Free users have help docs and Fin (AI bot). Human support is not directly available for Team/Enterprise non-owners.
claude.refund_policy: All payments are non-refundable except where required by law or in Consumer Terms of Service. Disputed payments block refund processing.
claude.refund_process: Request via 'Get help' > 'Claude Refund Request'. iOS refunds must go through Apple. Historical Android refunds through Google.
claude.account_deletion: Users can delete accounts in account settings. If unable to login, use the Help Center messenger 'I can't login' option.
claude.usage_limits: Usage limits (conversation budget) reset over time. Length limits (context window) are fixed at 200K tokens (500K for some Enterprise models).
claude.context_management: Claude automatically summarizes long conversations if code execution is enabled to stay within context limits.
claude.content_filtering: Claude may block output to prevent replication of copyrighted material. Repeat violations may lead to account suspension.
claude.safety_reporting: Users can report/block content. Illegal content or TOS breaches can be reported via specific forms for UK/Australia users.
claude.government_support: Claude for Government has a separate support process and documentation.

visa.lost_stolen_card: Report immediately via local freephone numbers or +1 303 967 1096. Global Customer Assistance Service can block cards within 30 minutes.
visa.charge_dispute: Contact the card issuer or bank directly using the number on the card. Visa does not handle individual cardholder account disputes.
visa.merchant_limits: Merchants generally cannot set min/max limits, except in USA/territories where a US$10 minimum for credit cards is allowed.
visa.travelers_cheques_theft: Contact the issuer (e.g., Citicorp) immediately with serial numbers. Notify local police. Refunds typically arranged within 24 hours.
visa.identity_theft: If identity theft involves a Visa card, visit the Lost or Stolen card page to cancel/replace the card.
visa.fraud_protection: Visa provides 3-D Secure (formerly Verified by Visa) for additional e-commerce security. Issuers handle the authentication.
visa.atm_locator: Users can find over 2 million ATMs worldwide via Visa's ATM locator.
visa.scam_reporting: Visa does not request personal info via email/call. Report scams using Visa's name via contact-us form.
